description: A Pydantic class whose annotations build a validator: construction parses, coerces and checks every field or raises `ValidationError`.
Classmethod that validates a dict (or object) and returns a model; `model_validate_json` does the same from JSON text.
One dict per problem with `type` (stable code), `loc` (path tuple), `msg` (text that may change) and `input`.
Model config that reports unknown keys as `extra_forbidden` instead of ignoring them (the default).
Returns a new dict of the fields, with `include=`/`exclude=` and `mode="json"` options.
Builds a model without validation, for data already validated; never for untrusted input.
